en: 1 Chronicles 26

p.src: 1  For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

ja: のとおりである。コラ人では、アサフの
en: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
u.src: 1  For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

p.src: 2  Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

ja: 男ゼカリヤ、次男エディアエル、
en: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

ja: 男シェマヤ、次男エホザバド、
en: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
u.src: 4  Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

p.src: 5  Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
u.src: 5  Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

p.src: 6  Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

ja: まれ、父祖の家を治めた。
en: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
u.src: 6  Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

p.src: 7  The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

ja: らは、オテニ、レファエル、オベド、エルザバド。また彼らの親族エリフとセマクヤも勇士であった。
en: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
u.src: 7  The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

p.src: 8  All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

ja: これらは皆オベド・エドムの
たちは、奉仕に必要な力を備えた
であった。オベド・エドムの子孫は六十二人。
en: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
u.src: 8  All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

p.src: 9  Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

en: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.
u.src: 9  Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

p.src: 10  Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

en: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
u.src: 10  Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

p.src: 11  Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

ja: 男はゼカリヤ。ホサの息
en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
u.src: 11  Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

p.src: 12  Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.

ja: 以上が門衛の組分けである。これらの
en: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.

p.src: 13  They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

ja: ごとに、年少者も年長者も同じように、各
の担当を決めるためくじを
en: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
u.src: 13  They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

p.src: 14  The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

ja: のくじはシェレムヤに
ゼカリヤのためにくじを
en: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
u.src: 14  The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

p.src: 15  To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

en: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
u.src: 15  To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

p.src: 16  To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

ja: り坂にあるシャレケテの
en: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.
u.src: 16  To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

p.src: 17  Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

en: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.
u.src: 17  Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

p.src: 18  For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

ja: 側のパルバルでは、上り坂に
en: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
u.src: 18  For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

p.src: 19  These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

en: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

en: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

ja: ら、すなわちラダンに属する父祖の家のかしらは、エヒエリ人であった。
en: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
u.src: 21  The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

en: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.

en: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
u.src: 23  Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

en: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

ja: その親族は、エリエゼルから、その
en: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

ja: このシェロモテとその
たちは、聖別された物のすべての宝物庫を管理した。それらはダビデ
してささげたものであった。

en: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.

ja: したすべてのものも含まれていた。だれが何を

en: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

査され、ギルアデのヤゼルで
